ClearingAccount.name: Clearing Account
ClearingAccount.definition: Identifies the clearing member account at the Central counterparty through which the trade must be cleared (sometimes called position account).

NonClearingMember.name: Non Clearing Member
NonClearingMember.definition: Provides the identification for the non-clearing member.

DeliveryAccount.name: Delivery Account
DeliveryAccount.definition: An account opened by the central counterparty in the name of the clearing member or its settlement agent within the account structure, for settlement purposes (gives information about the clearing member/its settlement agent account at the central securities depository).

FinancialInstrumentIdentification.name: Financial Instrument Identification
FinancialInstrumentIdentification.definition: Provides details about the security identification.

AccruedInterestAmount.name: Accrued Interest Amount
AccruedInterestAmount.definition: Interest that has accumulated on a bond since the last interest payment up to, but not including, the settlement date.

AverageDealPrice.name: Average Deal Price
AverageDealPrice.definition: This is the price of the trade.

NetQuantity.name: Net Quantity
NetQuantity.definition: Identifies the quantity of the trade leg.

SecuritiesMovementType.name: Securities Movement Type
SecuritiesMovementType.definition: Indicates the securities movement direction, that is, whether this is a delivery or return.

Depository.name: Depository
Depository.definition: Place at which a trade settles.

TradingCapacity.name: Trading Capacity
TradingCapacity.definition: Identifies the trading capacity of the seller.

PlaceOfTrade.name: Place Of Trade
PlaceOfTrade.definition: Place at which the security is traded.

TradeDate.name: Trade Date
TradeDate.definition: Provides the date of the trade.

TradeLegDetails.name: Trade Leg Details
TradeLegDetails.definition: Provides the trade leg details such as trade leg identification and trade type.

DepositoryOrPlaceOfListingPresenceRule.definition: At least Depository or PlaceOfListing must be present.
